items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: So he sat down there beside the piano and I said, 'Well, Henry, read the words off.' ... so I started writing the music and inside twenty minutes, we had the opening.

ctx.x: "Tweet-tweet, twat-twat." That was the first of the scat singers. The same as -- this was a new period coming in altogether and they came in with us at the Nest. Now when I went to the Nest, it was the first time I had had some experience in composing, I guess. But all of a sudden that's come to me and I had my song, "Walk, Jenny, Walk". A fellow come in, Johnny Carey come home and said, "I want you to meet one of our old songwriters, Henry Creamer." Henry Creamer had written "Way Down South in New Orleans",…
What is that song like. Do you remember the song, "Walk, Jenny, Walk".
